sentence: Never let a twimposter near a buncin man's grill.

wombos.definition: An unc who is bussin — an older man whose food, style, or energy is exceptionally good.
wombos.example: Grandpa's ribs were buncin at the cookout.

wombos.definition: Someone who pretends to be your twin or twin-coded equivalent — a fake counterpart who mimics your identity or vibe without the genuine connection.
wombos.example: Don't trust him — he's a twimposter trying to copy everything I do.
